observations: body L1-L3: the method is right: in the triangle ♈HC, right-angled at H, with the angle ε at the first point of Aries, tg ♈H = tg ♈C cos ε and sin HC = sin ♈C sin ε; so ♈H, entered as a right ascension in the table of right ascensions, gives ♈C as the corresponding arc of the ecliptic, and the declination of that arc in the table of the declination of the Sun is HC = β′. The 90° are added because the table counts the right ascensions from the beginning of Capricorn (note 1).
body L2-L3: the dash of the folios is printed at the end of L2, after «177,v.» (4.2 pt), and again at the head of L3, before «178,r.)» (5.6 pt).
body L4: the head of the notes on chapter 26, «Ad» and «caput» in small capitals, in the larger type of the heads.
body L5: in the head, the dash after «a)» measures 10.3 pt; a speck under the period after «38» makes it look like a colon.
body L8: in «expositis» the o is printed broken, open at the top.
body L8, L10, L20, L29: the dashes of «39–40», «59–61» and «33–34» are long dashes (5.5 pt in L8).
body L11, L37: the dashes of the letter-spaced «al–Battānī» are long dashes (5.5 and 5.4 pt).
body L22-L23: Delambre's difference is right: 64° 20′ 27″ − 54° 19′ = 10° 1′ 27″.
body L26-L28: Nallino's remark is right: 64° 19′ falls short of 64° 20′ 27″ by one minute when the seconds are neglected.
body L31: a speck stands above the line between «est» and «falsas».
